title: Simple Delicious Grilled Chicken Wings
description: Grilling frozen chicken wings? Yes! This simple technique-driven recipe skips the defrosting step and keeps the sauce on the wings and not your fingers.
ingredients: 1 cup hot pepper sauce (such as Frank's RedHot®)
4 pounds frozen chicken wings, or more to taste

steps.text: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium heat and lightly oil the grate.
Heat hot sauce and butter in a saucepan over low heat until butter melts. Off heat, stir until hot sauce and butter are well combined.
Grill wings until no longer sticking to the grate, 10 to 15 minutes. Flip wings; grill until mostly cooked through, about 10 minutes more.

Shut heat on one side of the grill. Dip 3 or 4 wings at a time into sauce; place over indirect heat. Grill until cooked through and the juices run clear, 15 to 20 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted near but not touching bones should read 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).
Place wings in a large bowl. Cover with aluminum foil; set aside for 10 minutes or until ready to serve.
